new_result.scope: For B of signature (2,1), U uniform on a centered unit interval, arbitrary unit macro direction v and 0<=q<1, the compensated hybrid Y=G+sqrt(q)vU with Cov(G)=(I-qvv^T)/12 satisfies p_{Y^TBY}(0)<=3sqrt(2), strict for q>0. This is cone-tip only, not a global-density theorem for the compensated hybrid.
new_result.key_scalar_lemma: H(x)=sqrt(1+x) integral_{-1/2}^{1/2} exp(-6xu^2)du <=1 for all x>=0, strict for x>0.
new_result.orientation_rigidity: If t is squared macro projection on the minority eigenaxis, p(0)/(3sqrt2)=1-(3q^2/80)(19+2t-13t^2)/8+O(q^3); second-order penalty uniquely minimized at t=1.

exact_witness.scope: Entrywise-dense (4m+1)-variable target matrices with exact active spectrum {1,1,-1} and one leverage-1/2 physical row.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For the uncompensated q=1/2 dense finite target family with exact active spectrum {1,1,-3/2}, limsup ||p_m||_infinity <= 3.9715052655710787928..., hence ||p_m||_infinity<3.98 for all sufficiently large m.
partner_result_applied.finite_stage_bridge: Pinned Fresnel-Brascamp-Lieb Theorem F at math-open-problems@e5f71d79eff325201dd0274053d20268ce65b837 gives an integrable characteristic-function envelope and uniform density convergence.

unresolved_implication: One-macro Gaussian-residual mechanisms are now constrained; possible overshoot still requires multiple interacting macro rows, non-Gaussian residual shape, or additional active spectrum before aggregation.
next_step: Analyze exact two-macroscopic-row hybrids with non-collinear rows and derive a two-parameter cone-tip formula or a source-valid finite witness; test whether compensation can create an overshoot above 3sqrt(2).
